2.12.14
Image.Visibility
The Image.Visibility element specifies whether an Image is hidden. This element is optional. This
element is of type Visibility.
Following is the parent element of the Image.Visibility element.
Parent elements
Image
The following is the XML Schema definition of the Image.Visibility element.
 <xsd:element name="Visibility" type="VisibilityType" minOccurs="0" />
